example_prompt: List a bank's branches to fill bank.branch for a Ghanaian (or RWF, SLL, UGX, XAF, XOF) payout recipient.

id.description: Path parameter. The Bank's unique ID.

swift_code.description: The SWIFT code for the bank.

message.description: Present on 401/403/409 bodies; the 400 body has none.

type.description: Error category. Generic: REQUEST_NOT_VALID, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, RESOURCE_CONFLICT, UNPROCESSABLE, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; or a domain type (see code).

code.description: String. Generic 10400/10401/10403/10404/10409/10422/10500, or a domain code documented for this endpoint: none specific.

gotchas: Auth (OAuth2 client credentials): POST grant_type=client_credentials, client_id and client_secret as application/x-www-form-urlencoded to https://idp.flutterwave.com/realms/flutterwave/protocol/openid-connect/token (same token URL for sandbox and production), then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Docs (Authentication): "Each token is valid for **10 minutes**"; "We recommend refreshing the token at least one minute before it expires." Cache the token. FLUTTERWAVE_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS = base64(client_id:client_secret) is an afrotools convention, decoded locally; Flutterwave never receives it. Sandbox base URL: https://developersandbox-api.flutterwave.com ("We archive your test data after 30 days.")

Headers: X-Trace-Id is optional on this GET (the headers guide lists it under 'Optional API Headers'; "It must be a string using only alphanumeric ASCII characters.", 12-255 characters). The API reference documents no X-Idempotency-Key for this endpoint.
The path id is the bank's id from list_banks (bnk_…), not its code.

Branches are required for recipient types bank_ghs, bank_rwf, bank_sll, bank_ugx, bank_xaf and bank_xof. Docs (Bank Account Transfers): "Required only for certain currency transfers (e.g., GHS bank transfers)." Use data[].code as recipient.bank.branch: the guide asks for the "bank branch code" and its GHS example sends "branch": "001".

Errors: {"status":"failed","error":{"type","code","message","validation_errors"}}; error.code is a string and 400s carry validation_errors[{field_name,message}]. Besides the generic codes (10400 REQUEST_NOT_VALID, 10401, 10403 FORBIDDEN, 10404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, 10409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT, 10422 UNPROCESSABLE, 10500) the error table documents these for this endpoint: none specific. Branch on error.type / error.code, not on the HTTP status alone. Docs (Errors): "The current limit is 500 API requests per minute." A 429 can come back as a non-JSON page ("HTML error pages such as `Cloudflare 1015 responses`"): parse error bodies defensively and back off exponentially with jitter.
